qt: to the Commission Claudiu-Richard Târziu (ECR) Subject:

Romania has significant research capacity and promising researchers and projects, but the transition from research results to innovative companies and competitive products remains difficult. Romanian small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) also face obstacles in accessing finance and scaling up advanced technologies. Will the Commission consider introducing additional mechanisms or incentives to help companies in central and eastern Europe move from research and innovation projects to commercialisation, scale-up and international expansion?
